name: Computer control
description: ATENA also lives on your Windows PC as a digital assistant, a bit like Gemini on Android: call it by voice ("Atena…") or with Ctrl+Alt+Space, it answers out loud, looks at the screen or webcam when you ask, and works for you: it creates folders and files, opens documents and apps, helps you write, build websites and use AutoCAD or Archicad.
capabilities: Voice assistant on the PC: wake word «Atena», answers with ATENA's neural voice, Esc to interrupt
Sees what you see: reads the document or page you are working on and, when needed, looks at the screen or webcam
Works for you: creates folders and files, opens documents, apps and websites, types or pastes text into the open app
Project help: websites ready in Visual Studio Code, AutoCAD scripts (.scr/.lsp), step-by-step Archicad guidance
Safe by design: writes only in your folders, never deletes, asks before overwriting
Remote control of PCs via WinRM/SSH from the Dashboard, with End-to-End encryption

guide.title: What it is and what it's for (in plain words)
guide.text: With the Windows Assistant, ATENA also "lives" on your computer. It appears as a small glowing orb in the corner of the screen: unobtrusive, but always ready. Call it by saying "Atena…", pressing Ctrl+Alt+Space, or clicking the orb to type. It answers out loud, can read the document you're working on, look at the screen or webcam (only when you ask) and do things for you: create folders and files, open programs, write text, prepare a website.
guide.tip: The intelligence stays on the ATENA server: the PC only runs a light program acting as ears, eyes and hands.

guide.title: Before you start: what you need
steps: A Windows 10 or 11 PC on the same network (same Wi-Fi or router) as the computer running ATENA.
Python 3.10 or newer on the Windows PC. If missing, the launcher opens the download page itself: during setup tick "Add Python to PATH" (very important).
Optional but recommended: microphone and speakers (or headphones) to talk to ATENA, a webcam if you want it to be able to look at you.

guide.title: Download and install the assistant
steps: From the Windows PC open this page and press "Download the Windows Assistant".
Open Downloads, right-click ATENA_Assistente_Windows.zip → "Extract All…". Choose a short path, e.g. C:/ATENA (very long paths can cause errors).
In the extracted folder double-click Start_ATENA_Assistente.bat. If the blue "Windows protected your PC" warning appears, click "More info" and then "Run anyway".
The first time a black window prepares the components: it takes 1-3 minutes. Later starts are instant.
guide.tip: If Windows asks to allow Python network access, choose "Private networks" and press "Allow".

guide.title: Connect the PC to ATENA (with a code)
steps: In the ATENA admin panel open Features → Nodes and servers and press "+ Add a node": a 6-digit code valid for a few minutes appears.
In the "Collega questo PC ad ATENA" window the ATENA address is already filled in. Type the code and a name for the PC (e.g. Studio).
Keep "Avvia ATENA all'accensione del PC" ticked if you want it to always start by itself, then press "Collega".
The glowing orb appears bottom right: ATENA is ready. The PC also shows up in the Nodes list.

guide.title: Everyday use
steps: To talk: say "Atena" followed by your request, or press Ctrl+Alt+Space. While listening the orb pulses blue, while thinking it turns purple, while speaking it turns green.
To type: click the orb, write in the box at the bottom and press Enter. The panel closes by itself when not needed.
To interrupt it while speaking: press Esc. Right-click the orb to pause the microphone, open settings or quit.
You can drag the orb wherever you like: it remembers the position.

guide.title: Things you can ask
steps: "Create a folder Quotes 2026 on the Desktop with Clients and Suppliers inside"
"Summarize the document I'm reading" or "Fix the mistakes in the text I'm writing"
"Write a polite email to move the meeting to Thursday" (ATENA types it directly into the open app)
"Create a website for a pizzeria and open it in Visual Studio Code"
"In AutoCAD how do I make a polar array?" or "Prepare an AutoCAD script that draws a 5x5 grid"
"Look at my screen: what am I doing wrong in this Archicad drawing?"
"Open Excel", "Open the Downloads folder", "Find the contract file"
Everything else works as usual: "What's the weather tomorrow?", "Turn on the studio light", "Play some music".

guide.title: Privacy and security
steps: The microphone sends audio only to ATENA on your network; ATENA wakes only when it hears its name. You can turn off continuous listening in settings (Ctrl+Alt+Space keeps working).
Screen and webcam are used only when your request needs them: the webcam turns on for an instant and off again. You can forbid it entirely in settings.
ATENA writes only in your user folder and Windows folders (Documents, Desktop, Downloads…), never deletes anything and asks before replacing an existing file.
It never starts programs or scripts on its own: it only opens apps from the Start menu.
To disconnect a PC: right-click the orb → Settings → "Scollega questo PC", or remove it from Nodes and servers.

guide.title: Troubleshooting
steps: The black window closes immediately or says Python is missing: install Python from python.org with "Add Python to PATH" ticked and run the .bat again.
"Invalid or expired pairing code": generate a new code in Nodes and servers and type it within a few minutes.
"ATENA not reachable": check the PC is on the same network and the address is ATENA's without the admin panel port (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
The orb is grey or ATENA doesn't hear you: ATENA's listening service may be off; meanwhile you can type by clicking the orb.
ATENA hears its own voice and interrupts itself: with speakers keep "Uso le cuffie" off.
For any other problem the log is in %APPDATA%/ATENA/assistant.log.

help.ATENA_RPA_PSK: No need to change it: it's created automatically. Change it only if you know what you're doing.
help.ATENA_RPA_AUTO_SYNC: When on, ATENA periodically checks by itself that connected PCs are on and reachable.
help.ATENA_RPA_DASHBOARD_LINK: For advanced users: add PCs manually via WinRM or SSH and check whether they are online.
help.ATENA_RPA_DOWNLOAD_LINK: Install it on every Windows PC where you want ATENA. The ZIP already contains this server's address.
help.ATENA_RPA_NODES: Leave empty. Only needed for old installations.
